fields.name: density
fields.rationale: Density is a key material property that affects the weight and structural performance of precast concrete elements.

fields.name: layer_thickness
fields.rationale: Layer thickness is important for understanding the structural and thermal properties of the concrete product.

fields.name: insulation_type
fields.rationale: The type of insulation integrated into the concrete affects its thermal performance and application suitability.

fields.name: load_bearing_capability
fields.rationale: Knowing whether the product is load-bearing or non-load-bearing is crucial for its application in construction projects.
evidence: suitable for the construction of above-ground and below-ground load-bearing or non-load-bearing interior and exterior walls
inference_basis: Technical purpose description indicates suitability for both load-bearing and non-load-bearing applications

fields.name: application_area
fields.rationale: The application area (interior, exterior, both) helps categorize the product based on its intended use in construction.
evidence: suitable for the construction of above-ground and below-ground load-bearing or non-load-bearing interior and exterior walls
inference_basis: Technical purpose description indicates suitability for both interior and exterior applications
